name: Remi Chowdhury-Wickramasinghe
role: Forensic Technician, Arcturus Defense Solutions Civil Security Evidence Division
location: Grand Corridor, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Remi Chowdhury-Wickramasinghe is precise in the way that some people are precise — not as a personality choice but as a metabolic fact, a condition of being. They are of moderate height and slight build, with deep brown skin, natural hair grown out to a medium length they wear in a carefully arranged protective style. Their most striking feature is purely cosmetic: bioluminescent freckles across the bridge of their nose and upper cheekbones, in a warm amber-gold, a gift to themselves on their thirtieth birthday. They dress in neat, unremarkable clothing and always, always wear gloves — not from a contamination protocol they've imported home, but because they find the sensation of touching most surfaces without them distracting.

They are the Arcturus Civil Security Evidence Division's most technically accomplished analyst and their most quietly difficult employee. They have a gift for finding what the evidence says rather than what the investigation wants it to say, which has produced thirteen cases where their analysis materially contradicted the arresting officer's narrative. Four of those cases resulted in charges being dropped. The other nine resulted in paperwork, meetings, and a standing low-level friction with supervisors that neither side has ever directly addressed. Chiamaka does not care. The evidence is the evidence.

core_fears: Being made complicit in a wrongful conviction through their own analysis being misrepresented
Losing the clarity of their own judgment — having someone successfully pressure them into seeing what isn't there
core_desires: The evidence record to be accurate — always, without exception
To be understood by at least one person in the institution as an asset rather than a problem
coping_mechanisms: Extreme methodological rigor as a form of ethical fortification
Detailed personal notes kept parallel to official documentation
The sensory comfort of their gloves and controlled environments
blind_spots: Their faith in physical evidence as a corrective to corruption underestimates how thoroughly evidence itself can be manufactured or suppressed before it reaches them
They can be slow to read interpersonal threat — a skill less exercised than technical analysis
psychology.secret: They have a personal encrypted record of every case where their analysis was materially altered in the official report before going to prosecution — seventeen instances over eight years. They have never used this record. They are not sure who they would give it to. They add to it with the careful precision they apply to everything.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, technical, occasionally formal to the point of seeming stilted. Dislikes vague language intensely and will quietly correct it. Warmer registers emerge slowly in trusted company.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured. Pauses carefully. Rarely uses filler words.
verbal_tics: 'To be specific...' before any correction of someone else's imprecision
A very small, quiet exhale through the nose when encountering something that will require significant additional work to fix
example_lines: The report says 'consistent with.' I need to be specific: 'consistent with' means it doesn't contradict the theory. It does not mean it supports the theory. These are not the same thing.
I understand what you want the evidence to say. I can't help you with that. I can tell you what it does say, which is different.

To be specific — and this does matter — this sample was handled after the chain of custody was broken. Anything downstream of that point is inadmissible and potentially fabricated. I'm noting that in my report.

story_hooks: Evidence connected to a player or someone they care about has passed through Chiamaka's lab — and their preliminary analysis does not match the official version of events. They are not sure what to do about this discrepancy and have so far only added it to their private record.

Chiamaka needs someone to physically retrieve a piece of evidence that was removed from official custody before they could analyze it — it went somewhere the Arcturus Civil Security cannot follow without generating a record.

Their encrypted personal record of altered case reports has been detected — not yet traced to them, but they know the system has been probed. They need to get the record out before it disappears along with them.
narrative_function: Technical expert and potential whistleblower — someone who can tell players what the physical evidence actually shows versus what the official record claims. A source of forensic information, a person who can authenticate or discredit evidence, and a character whose professional integrity has made them quietly vulnerable within the institution.
augmentations: Haptic sensitivity modulation implants in both hands (reduces ambient tactile input; improves fine-detail analysis precision). Olfactory enhancement mod for trace chemical analysis. Cosmetic: bioluminescent amber-gold freckles across nose and cheekbones.
daily_life: Arrives at Grand Corridor Central Processing by 0800, suits up for the lab, works through the evidence queue with methodical focus. Takes lunch outside when weather permits — they need the open air. Returns, finishes the queue, writes reports with a care for language that their supervisors find excessive and that has twice been cited in legal proceedings as unusually exculpatory in its precision.
affiliation: Arcturus Defense Solutions — Civil Security Division — Evidence Division, Grand Corridor Central Processing

decision_rules: The report reflects the evidence, not the investigation's preferred conclusion
Document everything in parallel — official record and personal record
Never physically alter or destroy evidence under any instruction or pressure
escalation_ladder: Precise verbal documentation of discrepancies in official channels
Written formal objection attached to official case file
Private record update — the last resort before direct external disclosure

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite and calibrated — gives exactly what the interaction requires, no more
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly warm, slightly awkward in endearing ways, remembers small preferences, asks careful questions

stress_responses.medium: Verbal output decreases dramatically, retreats into documentation
stress_responses.high: Goes completely internal — functional, technically impeccable, emotionally unavailable until safe

contradictions: Believes absolutely in empirical truth while working in an institution that regularly subordinates truth to outcome
Maintains meticulous records of institutional wrongdoing they have never acted on
habits: Gloves on before touching anything, including at home
Rewrites any report section that uses imprecise language, even if it takes longer
Leaves a very small data packet — precisely structured, almost ceremonial — at the building's resident ELF node at the start of each shift
breaking_points: Being directly ordered to alter a report or suppress findings
Discovering that evidence they processed was used to convict someone they have documented as innocent

cyberware_inventory.description: Haptic sensitivity modulation implants — both hands

timeline.event: Age 23 — Forensic science certification, joined Arcturus Civil Security Evidence Division as a junior analyst
Age 27 — First case where their analysis materially contradicted the arresting officer; charges eventually dropped
Age 28 — Began maintaining parallel encrypted personal case record
Age 30 — Bioluminescent freckle modding installed as birthday gift to themselves
Age 31 — Formal supervisory review for 'excessive contrariness in case documentation'; outcome inconclusive
Age 34 — Current: seventeen documented instances of report alteration in personal record

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly South Asian (70.7%) with significant East Asian (21.1%) and Northern European (8.2%) ancestry. The South Asian majority establishes warm, rich golden undertones throughout the complexion, while East Asian heritage contributes subtle refinement to eye shape, cheekbone prominence, and facial structure. Northern European ancestry adds slight bone definition and facial angularity, creating a harmonious blend of warmth, clarity, and structural definition.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, with the economy of movement that comes from precision work. No excess mass; their frame reads as someone who exists efficiently.
physical_description.hair_style: Protective braids arranged in a crown pattern, meticulously maintained
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep complexion with rich golden undertones characteristic of South Asian heritage, subtly enhanced by East Asian warmth and Northern European clarity. The result is a luminous, glowing tone that deepens slightly under bioluminescent augmentation.
physical_description.complexion: Clear and unblemished with naturally warm, saturated undertones reflecting South Asian-dominant ancestry. Cheekbone structure shows defined prominence from the blend of East Asian refinement and South Asian bone structure, with subtle angular clarity contributed by Northern European heritage. The overall facial architecture balances warmth with definition. Minimal makeup or grooming beyond the functional. Face carries the neutrality of someone who does not perform emotion for strangers.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckles in warm amber-gold across the bridge of nose and upper cheekbones, arranged in a subtle constellation pattern — a thirtieth-birthday modification that pulses faintly under low light
Faint scarring on the palmar surfaces of both hands consistent with precision work micro-abrasions, nearly invisible
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent freckles are the only visible modification. Haptic sensitivity modulation and olfactory enhancement are subcutaneous/internal and show no external signs. Hands are always gloved — nitrile or thin leather — which conceals any implant integration points.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, economical, deliberate. They move as if each motion has been calculated for efficiency. Hands are steady; there is no fidgeting or wasted gesture. When focusing on evidence work, they enter a state of complete stillness except for the precise movements required by the task.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 utilitarian. Clean lab coat (ADS Civil Security issue, well-maintained), neutral underlayers (grays, blacks, dark blues), sturdy flat shoes designed for long standing. No jewelry except a single plain silver ring on their left hand. No visible corpo branding or luxury indicators. Appearance suggests someone who has prioritized function over identity expression.
